name: io.github.pressa-dev/pressa
title: Pressa - LaTeX to PDF
description: Compile LaTeX to PDF without installing TeX Live. No API key needed to start.

environmentVariables.name: PRESSA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server exposes only compile, which works keyless within a daily allowance. A free key from pressa.dev raises the limits and registers the template, asset and render tools.
